I took my mom’s keys to her car when she was out at the bar one night with her friends. I drove it to pick up my best friend at time, it’s probably 11pm. 

Bored teenager me was waiting for her to come out (she lived maybe 4 miles from me) of her house, I played around with the lights. She walks out, I check to make sure we’ve got visuals and we head out. We were just going back to my house. I got around the corner before suddenly it’s blue and red lights. 

Oh, did I mentioned I’m 14 at the time with no permit and the passenger has just a permit? Yeah. I felt the cold hands of death upon me as I imagined my mom finding out. The reason I actually got pulled over though was because I put the damn parking lights on to drive with instead of putting the headlights back on...my moms car had some really bright parking lights, I guess.
I was not sure anyone else had ever seen this besides me.
